payload.comment:
Profiling stage is structurally complete and internally consistent. Class counts sum correctly across all splits (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180), no duplicates, no blank images, and all integrity hashes are present. The data profile correctly identifies the significant test-domain shift (test imbalance ratio 3.95 vs train 1.63; debris prevalence drops to 0.41×, stroma to 0.56×) and documents label-ambiguity risks for non-standard classes (debris, background, stroma vs smooth muscle). Train/val near-identical proportions confirm a single-site random split, making the CRC-VAL-HE-7K test set the sole external generalization probe.

Carry-forward warnings (non-blocking):
1. llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama). The profiling decision_source is this unpinned model. While the structured profiling metrics (counts, proportions, channel stats) are deterministic, the narrative ambiguity notes and risk assessments are LLM-generated without a reproducible model fingerprint. This should be flagged in the run manifest for any downstream stage that relies on LLM-generated text.
2. The ambiguity_risks text references '96×96 patch resolution' but the actual image_shape_hwc is [28,28,3] (PathMNIST is a downsampled derivative of the original 96×96 TCGA patches). This is a minor narrative inaccuracy in the LLM-generated text; the structured data is correct. Downstream stages should reference the actual 28×28 resolution when discussing spatial context limitations.
3. Small per-class test counts (debris n=339, stroma n=421, smooth muscle n=592) will yield high-variance per-class metrics. Downstream evaluation should report confidence intervals or use macro-averaged metrics with explicit caveats.

No deterministic findings were raised. The profiling artefacts are sufficient to proceed to the next stage. All warnings are documentation/reproducibility concerns that should be propagated but do not invalidate the profiling results.
